setting: A covered farmhouse porch overlooking fenced fields and a small farm pond, in one locked-off wide photorealistic shot
pet: A farm dog asleep on a woven mat beside the porch rail, with both ears and its tail visible
props: a steaming enamel mug on a side table
signature: Gentle rain stipples the farm pond beyond the porch, sending overlapping ripples across its reflection of the sky
signature_detail: A tiny snail crawls along the flat, rain-damp porch step in the lower left of the picture, pausing at a knothole
stages: farm pond beyond the fence, dimpled by rain
flat porch step in the near foreground with a tiny snail
side table beside the sleeping dog with a steaming mug
foreground: Weathered porch boards, the damp step, a woven dog mat and a small side table
midground: Open porch rail, rain-dark fence posts and grassy fields
background: A farm pond and low tree line beneath an overcast blue-hour sky
light: Cool, soft light from the open porch, warmed by the hanging lantern
title_idea: Gentle Rain at Farmhouse Porch | 10 Hours of Cozy Farm Ambience
intro_lines: Welcome to the porch, come listen to the rain with us

pick_scores.note: Calm wide view with a prominent pond and lantern. The dog is partly crowded by the table; mug steam and pond ripples are not distinct.
Readable depth and a clearly separated dog, mug, and lantern. The mug shows no steam, and rain on the pond is subtle.
Strong framing gives the pond and porch room to breathe. The dog's tail is hard to identify, and the mug has no visible steam.
Best balance of cozy porch, visible dog and tail, distinct light sources, and pond backdrop. Mug steam and overlapping pond ripples would need to be added in animation.
